svg.title: Flux: people and agents, one project
svg.desc: A short animation of a Flux project, Community garden sensors. Jonas asks: Should we measure soil moisture first? Ada turns the message into task #12 and accepts the decision Measure moisture before buying sensors. Kreska, as the agent Claude Code, picks up the task, reads the beds and writes a positive result into the Wiki. The Map links the message, task, decision and result, and a phone shows the same work in the Inbox. It ends on: People and agents, one project. Open source, self-hosted, your own agents.
